verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management product, so subtasks and task dependencies are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents subtasks, dependency links or blocking relationships. The evidence covers only creating and managing tasks in general (via the API and MCP), which is a different, more general capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
